title: Athlumney, Navan, Co. Meath, C15E8C1
description:
Lydon Farrell Property are privileged to present this 4/5 bedroom detached home on a very large site, situated within walking distance of Navan in the much-desired Athlumney area. This attractive home has been proudly owned by the current family since its construction and was originally designed with a good layout, with a real feature being the 0.75-acre site of landscaped gardens, which includes mature trees. The subject site is fully zoned residential, which may allow for future development.

This family home is spacious throughout, extending to approximately 135 sq. m, and benefits from a block-built two-car garage. The accommodation on the ground floor includes a large entrance hall, a large dual-aspect living room, a dining room, a kitchen, a guest WC and a ground-floor bedroom, currently being used as a second living room. On the first floor, there are a further four spacious bedrooms and a family bathroom. This family home has been very well maintained throughout and allows an incoming purchaser the opportunity to move in immediately, with the potential to upgrade over time.

This premium home is surrounded by beautiful gardens and mature trees, which provide the feeling of country living while living in the heart of Athlumney, Navan. This family home is superbly located within walking distance of Johnstown and Navan, providing access to all local amenities, including both primary and secondary schools, sporting amenities, hotels, shops, restaurants and bars. The property enjoys excellent access to Dublin City due to its close proximity to the M3, N3 and N2 routes.

Family homes on large sites such as this rarely come to the market.

Viewings by appointment.
